calibration.wheel_speed_sign_method: corr(w_axis_i, v_cmd) >= 0 on near-straight commanded segments
calibration.torque_sign_method: corr(tau_axis_i, vdot) >= 0 on near-straight acceleration segments
calibration.yaw_sign_method: corr(tau_diff, rdot) >= 0 on rotate runs (flip r if negative)

notes.v_source: v=Rw/2*(wR+wL) from ODrive vel_estimate after per-axis speed sign calibration
notes.torque_source: ODrive torque_estimate after per-axis torque sign calibration
notes.r_source: IMU angular_velocity.z after yaw-rate sign calibration
notes.recommended_low_speed: omit c2 (default) and typically keep d1=0 unless wide velocity range is available
